title: M5 stage 5: bounded CRT connectivity repair
scope: Five targets proving the original section5 repair bound; no full-M5 completion claim

metadata.obligation: Shared objects and exact root statement; definition correspondence review
Existence/computation of t(F), `F ∣ M N ↔ t(F) ∣ N` for positive N; repeated factors and F=1
Anchoring by independent translations preserves signature and connectivity
Binary additive-character orthogonality, including dimension zero
Character product coefficient equals the k-subset residue count
Signed binomial coefficient formula evaluates that coefficient without subset enumeration
Character power sum counts ordered residue tuples with repetition, including length zero
Squarefree divisors of `rad(M_N/F)` detect exact complete gcd, retaining the next multiplicity exclusion
Integer divisor Möbius indicator detects combined support gcd one
C equals the number of connected anchored weight-w pairs of exact signature F; inadmissible cases zero
Selected/available completion formula is exact for both blocks
Positive C deterministically yields a valid pair in at most `2(N-1)` position decisions
A equals the number of feasible anchored ordered residue patterns
Conditional tuple counts recover a feasible pattern in at most `2(w-1)T` candidate tests
Every connected physical source reduces to a feasible period pattern
Pack each residue's multiplicities into distinct anchored exponents at most `wT-1`, preserving reduction
A shift of one positive first-block exponent by kT makes total support gcd one, preserving weight and residues, with every exponent below `wT(T+2)`
Ordinary G has constant term one, `gcd(G,M_T)=F`, and degree at most `wT-1` because the second block is unchanged
`E=t(G) ≤ 2^deg(G)` and `T ∣ E`, including G=1
Same literal supports have exact F at all `N=T+jE` above their support cutoff; ring congruence preserves multiplicities
Positive A constructs a connected source below `B=wT(T+2)+2^(wT)` and an infinite progression
`A>0` iff any-order connected realization exists; A=0 is a global nonrealizability certificate
A realization requires `T ∣ N` and `max(w,deg(F)+1) ≤ N`
The bounded minimum of positive C values is nonempty and is the exact first birth; recover its witness
Every proposed order is classified by exact C; positive reconstructs and zero proves sector absence
All invoked evaluations are finite factorization, divisor, character, power and binomial arithmetic; reconstruction terminates without raw pair scans
At w=1 the only connected anchored source is N=1 with F=1
Assemble the full original arithmetic M5 theorem for all positive weights and complete signatures

spec.name: M5.CRT.safe_prime_residue
spec.statement: ∀ p δ T e : ℕ, p.Prime → p ∣ δ → Nat.gcd (Nat.gcd T δ) e = 1 → ¬ p ∣ e + M5.CRT.repairResidue e p * T
spec.guidance: Split on p | e. If false the residue is zero. If true residue is one; p | T would force p | gcd(gcd T δ)e = 1, contradicting primality. Exclude p | e+T by subtracting the known divisible summand. Includes p=2. Return tactic lines only, without a leading by. Preserve the exact target.

spec.name: M5.CRT.prime_crt_representative
spec.statement: ∀ δ e : ℕ, 0 < δ → ∃ r : ℕ, r < M5.CRT.primeProduct δ ∧ ∀ p ∈ δ.primeFactors, Nat.ModEq p r (M5.CRT.repairResidue e p)
spec.guidance: Use Nat.chineseRemainderOfFinset with t=δ.primeFactors, modulus identity, residues M5.CRT.repairResidue e. Nat.prime_of_mem_primeFactors supplies nonzero moduli; Nat.coprime_primes supplies pairwise coprimality for distinct indices. The subtype property gives congruences and Nat.chineseRemainderOfFinset_lt_prod gives strict product bound. Empty set δ=1 is allowed. Unfold primeProduct and use open scoped BigOperators if needed. Return tactic lines only, without a leading by. Preserve the exact target.

spec.name: M5.CRT.interval_representative
spec.statement: ∀ R r w : ℕ, 0 < R → ∃ k : ℕ, w ≤ k ∧ k < w + R ∧ Nat.ModEq R k r
spec.guidance: Witness k=w+(r+(R-1)*w)%R. Nat.mod_lt bounds remainder. For congruence use w+(R-1)*w=R*w from R>0, rearrange additions, and Nat.add_mod. An alternate standard modular representative proof is fine; avoid requiring r<R or w>0. Return tactic lines only, without a leading by. Preserve the exact target.

spec.name: M5.CRT.residues_force_coprime
spec.statement: ∀ δ T e k : ℕ, 0 < δ → Nat.gcd (Nat.gcd T δ) e = 1 → (∀ p ∈ δ.primeFactors, Nat.ModEq p k (M5.CRT.repairResidue e p)) → Nat.gcd δ (e + k * T) = 1
spec.guidance: Apply Nat.coprime_of_dvd, whose conclusion unfolds to gcd=1. Every prime divisor of positive δ lies in primeFactors by Nat.Prime.mem_primeFactors. Transport supplied congruence through mul_right T and add_left e. Nat.ModEq.dvd_iff with dvd_refl p transports divisibility to the expression excluded by accepted safe_prime_residue. Return tactic lines only, without a leading by. Preserve the exact target.

spec.name: M5.CRT.bounded_connectivity_repair
spec.statement: ∀ δ T e w : ℕ, 0 < δ → 0 < T → Nat.gcd (Nat.gcd T δ) e = 1 → ∃ k : ℕ, w ≤ k ∧ k < w + δ ∧ Nat.gcd δ (e + k * T) = 1
spec.guidance: Let R=primeProduct δ. Finset.prod_pos and positivity of prime factors give R>0; Nat.prod_primeFactors_dvd δ and Nat.le_of_dvd give R≤δ. Obtain r via prime_crt_representative and k via interval_representative. For p in primeFactors, Finset.dvd_prod_of_mem gives p|R; Nat.ModEq.of_dvd descends the k≡r congruence then transitivity gives the local residue condition. Apply residues_force_coprime; weaken k<w+R to k<w+δ. Preserve original assumptions and final bound; δ=1 and p=2 are included. Return tactic lines only, without a leading by. Preserve the exact target.
